cases.sentence: Но Надав и Авиуд умерли перед Господом, когда принесли Ему чуждый огонь в ___.
cases.explain: «Синайской пустыне» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Nadab and Abihu died before Yahweh when they offered strange fire before Yahweh in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.

cases.sentence: — Я взял левитов из всех родов израильтян вместо первенцев ___.
cases.explain: «мужского пола» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine,

cases.explain: «Синайской пустыне» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

cases.sentence: Пересчитай всех людей ___ возрастом от месяца и старше.
cases.explain: «мужского пола» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”

cases.sentence: Всех перечисленных ___ возрастом от месяца и старше было семь тысяч пятьсот человек.
cases.explain: «мужского пола» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred.

cases.sentence: Всех ___ от месяца и старше было восемь тысяч шестьсот человек.
cases.explain: «мужского пола» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: According to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.

cases.sentence: ___ должны были ставить лагерь с южной стороны скинии.
cases.explain: «Каафитские кланы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.

cases.sentence: Каафитские кланы должны были ставить лагерь с ___ скинии.
cases.explain: «южной стороны» — after the preposition «с», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.

cases.sentence: Вождем семей ___ был Елицафан, сын Узиила.
cases.explain: «каафитских кланов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

cases.sentence: Всех исчисленных ___ от месяца и старше было шесть тысяч двести человек.
cases.explain: «мужского пола» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.

cases.sentence: Вождем семей ___ был Цуриил, сын Авихаила.
cases.explain: «мераритских кланов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.

cases.sentence: Они должны были вставать лагерем с ___ скинии.
cases.explain: «северной стороны» — after the preposition «с», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.

cases.sentence: Всего первенцев ___ от месяца и старше, перечисленных по именам, было двадцать две тысячи двести семьдесят три человека.
cases.explain: «мужского пола» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: All the firstborn males according to the number of names from a month old and upward, of those who were counted of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.
